items.title: GitLab Suspends Windows Exploit Researcher Nightmare-Eclipse After GitHub Ban

items.title: India’s CERT-In Asks Organizations to Patch Vulnerabilities in Systems Within 12 hours
items.description: India’s national computer emergency response agency CERT-In has warned enterprises to patch high-risk vulnerabilities on internet-facing and critical systems within 12 hours of discovery or active exploitation.
